items.title: 〈熱門股〉宣德低軌衛星業務明年估增3成 無懼大盤逆風飆漲停周漲15%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Xuan De (5457‑TW) Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellite Business Expected to Grow 30% Next Year, Rides Up Despite Market Headwinds, Hits Daily Limit, Up Over 15% This Week
paras: 連接器廠宣德(5457-TW)低軌衛星布局持續擴大，明年相關業務營收可望年增3成、占比將達1成以上，近期無懼大盤重挫，股價逆勢抗跌，周五收漲停23.75元、周漲逾15%。
宣德表示，2026至2028年為低軌衛星產業高速成長期，其中地面接收站相關產品年成長率可望突破4成，並積極擴大零組件布局，涵蓋內外部機構件、連接器及線束等，提高產品滲透率與單機價值。
其中，機殼相關專案今年已取得訂單，交由子公司台翰負責，目前已有少量出貨，預計2027年開始放量，進一步挹注營收，公司也將配合客戶全球擴張進程，持續推動低軌衛星業務規模化。
除低軌衛星外，宣德也持續拓展工控產品整機組裝業務，從過去以零組件供應為主，進一步延伸至整機組裝，應用涵蓋遊戲機台、POS機、ATM及安控設備等，目前已有專案進行中，且今年已開始貢獻營收。
此外，在工業及支付設備方面，宣德也布局專業耳機、POS機及RFID掃描器等產品，應用於地勤、客服及零售感應收銀等場景，相關產品今年同樣開始貢獻營收，成為既有消費電子業務以外的新成長來源。
paras_en: Connector maker Xuan De (5457‑TW) continues to expand its low‑Earth‑orbit satellite portfolio, with related revenue expected to increase 30% year‑over‑year next year and account for more than 10% of total sales. Recently the stock has resisted a broad market sell‑off, closing Friday at the daily limit of NT$23.75 and gaining more than 15% for the week.

Xuan De said the period 2026‑2028 will be a high‑growth phase for the LEO satellite industry, with ground‑station products projected to grow at an annual rate of over 40%. The company is actively expanding its component lineup, covering internal and external mechanical parts, connectors and wiring harnesses to boost product penetration and unit value.

The company’s enclosure‑related projects secured orders this year and were handed to its subsidiary Tai‑Han for production; a small volume has already been shipped, and volume production is expected to start in 2027, further fueling revenue. Xuan De will also align with customers’ global expansion plans to scale up its LEO satellite business.

Beyond LEO satellites, Xuan De is expanding its industrial‑control product assembly business, moving from a pure component supplier to full‑machine assembly. Applications include gaming machines, POS terminals, ATMs and security equipment; several projects are underway and have begun contributing to revenue this year.

In addition, in the industrial and payment‑equipment sectors, Xuan De is developing professional headsets, POS terminals and RFID scanners for use in ground‑crew, customer‑service and retail checkout scenarios. These products also started generating revenue this year, providing a new growth source beyond its existing consumer‑electronics business.

items.title: 做空AI交易開始獲利了結？ 《大賣空》貝瑞減半輝達、半導體ETF看跌期權
paras: 曾因精準預測美國房地產泡沫破裂而聲名大噪的電影《大賣空》原型投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry），開始部分落袋人工智慧（AI）做空交易的獲利。他周五（20日）透露，已將VanEck Vectors 半導體 ETF(SMH-US) 看跌期權部位減半，同時賣出所持有輝達(NVDA-US) 看跌期權的一半。
這項調整引發市場關注，外界開始重新評估貝瑞對AI產業的看空策略。不過，減碼並不代表他已經轉向看多，而是在AI概念股大幅回檔後，先行鎖定部分空頭交易收益。
就在減碼前一天，貝瑞才公開表示，自己先前已對輝達、CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 及Nebius(NBIS-US) 等AI基礎設施業者發出警告。
隨著AI交易熱度降溫，相關個股近期接連重挫，也讓他的看空論點再次成為市場焦點。

輝達、半導體ETF看跌期權各減半　貝瑞部分獲利了結

貝瑞此次調整主要涉及兩項空頭部位，分別是VanEck半導體ETF（SMH）及輝達看跌期權，兩者持倉均削減50%。
SMH涵蓋輝達、台積電(2330-TW) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 及美光科技(MU-US) 等主要半導體業者，輝達也是ETF中權重最大的成分股之一。因此，透過SMH看跌期權布局，等於押注半導體產業整體股價進一步走弱。
這並非貝瑞首次在市場下跌後調節空頭部位。11月初，半導體股遭遇大幅賣壓後，他曾賣出四分之一的SMH看跌期權，理由是部分獲利了結。11月12日，他又買回先前減碼部位中的一部分，相當於補回原先減持部位的25%。
另一方面，貝瑞當時將那斯達克100指數看跌期權部位加倍，進一步押注科技股下跌。
從這些操作來看，貝瑞並非單純持有空頭部位等待市場崩跌，而是隨著行情變化調整曝險，在股價下跌、看跌期權價值上升後適度獲利了結，再視市場情況決定後續布局。
因此，此次同步削減SMH與輝達看跌期權各半，較像是階段性鎖定收益，而非正式放棄對AI產業的看空立場。

貝瑞前一天才示警輝達、CoreWeave與Nebius

就在減碼前一天，也就是11月19日，貝瑞再次公開談論自己對AI基礎設施類股的看法。
他在社群媒體上表示，先前已試圖向輝達、CoreWeave、Nebius及半導體產業投資人發出警告，並特別強調，自己並未直接建議投資人放空這些股票，但已提供足以讓投資人考慮賣出的資訊。
貝瑞過去持續質疑AI基礎設施投資的可持續性，尤其關注輝達晶片生態系與算力租賃業者之間的高度依賴關係。
CoreWeave與Nebius等「新雲端」（Neocloud）業者，主要透過採購輝達晶片建置資料中心，再向AI企業出租運算能力，商業模式高度仰賴輝達的產品供應、市場地位，以及AI算力需求。
貝瑞先前認為，這些業者在很大程度上受惠於輝達的市場影響力，但隨著輝達市場地位及AI基礎設施產業競爭格局出現變化，這類商業模式也可能面臨新的挑戰。

輝達連七個交易日收黑　AI基礎設施股跌勢更劇烈

貝瑞調整持倉之際，AI交易熱度明顯降溫，輝達及半導體類股近期接連遭遇賣壓。
自11月12日輝達執行長黃仁勳辭職的消息公布後，輝達股價持續承壓，周五跌勢進一步擴大，單日收跌約14%。截至當日收盤，輝達已連續七個交易日收黑，期間累計下跌約27.7%，全周跌幅約23%。
值得注意的是，輝達本周二美股盤後公布的季度財報及財測均優於預期，仍未能扭轉股價跌勢，顯示市場對管理層變動及AI投資能否持續的疑慮，已成為影響股價的重要因素。
AI基礎設施類股跌幅更為顯著。根據先前媒體統計，截至11月20日，CoreWeave與Nebius股價較10月初各自高點分別下跌逾50%及60%，半導體產業也遭遇明顯拋售。
社群媒體上，有投資人根據相關股票的階段性高點計算跌幅，指出輝達、半導體ETF、CoreWeave及Nebius分別下跌約32%、38%、51%及57%，並調侃貝瑞可能成為這波AI泡沫爭論中的贏家。
不過，相關個股的跌幅並不等於貝瑞實際期權部位的報酬率。看跌期權的履約價格、到期日、買進成本及實際交易時間，都會影響最終獲利。
貝瑞此次減持兩類看跌期權，顯示他已開始部分實現AI做空交易的收益，但仍保留一定程度的空頭部位。隨著輝達及AI基礎設施類股持續承壓，市場接下來將關注，他究竟認為這波跌勢已足以實現部分獲利，還是正為後續進一步布局調整資金與持倉。

items.title: 美銀：標普跌破7000點可買入 但市場低估「硬著陸」風險
items.title_en: BofA: S&P Below 7,000 Is a Buying Opportunity, but Market Underestimates Hard‑Landing Risk
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，美國銀行策略師 Michael Hartnett 表示，若美國經濟能避免衰退，標普 500 指數跌破 7,000 點將具備買進吸引力。不過，他警告，華爾街對經濟硬著陸的風險定價不足，投資人應等待市場主軸從聯準會升息轉向降息，再進場布局風險資產。
Hartnett領導的策略團隊指出，市場接下來的走向，取決於聯準會面對金融市場動盪時，是否願意調整政策。
如果聯準會仍是「華爾街最好的朋友」，企業信用市場與標普 500 指數持續下滑，所引發的市場動盪可能迫使升息循環提前中斷。但若聯準會在期中選舉後轉為「強硬抗通膨者」，經濟硬著陸風險就會升高。
這番警告出現在聯準會官員接連釋出鷹派訊號之際。
聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩勒姆 (Alberto Musalem) 談及，明年春季前可能需要多達四次升息。
聯準會理事華勒 (Christopher Waller) 則表示，央行應考慮在 12 月升息 2 碼，即 0.5 個百分點。
標普 500 指數週四收在 7,175.83 點，已低於 200 日均線逾 2%。
Hartnett認為，在經濟軟著陸、也就是美國避免陷入衰退的情境下，標普 500 指數跌破 7,000 點會是買點。這項判斷帶有明確前提，並非單憑指數跌至特定位置，就足以支持進場。
然而，多數投資人對經濟前景仍偏向樂觀。美銀週二公布的基金經理人調查顯示，半數受訪者預期經濟軟著陸，另有 42% 預期「不著陸」，亦即經濟持續成長、甚至加速，僅 3% 預期衰退。
「我們認為，市場對硬著陸可能性的估計太低。」Hartnett表示。
他擔心，市場可能陷入惡性循環：當國內生產毛額 (GDP) 與企業每股盈餘 (EPS) 預估遭下修，投資人隨之降低股票配置，進一步加重既有持股的賣壓。
Hartnett指出，目前投資人正「躲進」低波動與防禦型股票，反映資金在市場震盪中尋求相對穩定的部位。
在操作時機上，他建議，投資人應等待市場敘事從聯準會升息轉向降息，再買進他所稱的「景氣循環五個 C」：加密貨幣 (Crypto)、晶片 (Chips)、銅 (Copper)、消費 (Consumer) 與住宅房地產 (Condos)。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett said if the U.S. economy can avoid a recession, a drop of the S&P 500 below 7,000 points would become an attractive buying opportunity. However, he warned that Wall Street is under‑pricing the risk of a hard landing and investors should wait for the market narrative to shift from Fed rate hikes to cuts before positioning in risk assets.
Hartnett’s strategy team noted that the market’s next direction will depend on whether the Fed is willing to adjust policy amid financial‑market turbulence.

If the Fed remains “Wall Street’s best friend,” a continued decline in corporate credit markets and the S&P 500 could trigger market turmoil that forces an early end to the rate‑hike cycle. But if the Fed turns into a “hard‑line anti‑inflationist” after the midterm elections, the risk of a hard landing rises.
The warning comes as Fed officials are repeatedly issuing hawkish signals.
St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said there could be as many as four rate hikes before next spring.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller said the central bank should consider a 0.5‑percentage‑point (two‑basis‑point) hike in December.
The S&P 500 closed Thursday at 7,175.83, more than 2% below its 200‑day moving average.

Hartnett believes that in a soft‑landing scenario—where the U.S. avoids recession—a dip of the S&P 500 below 7,000 would be a buying point. This judgment carries a clear premise and is not based solely on the index reaching a specific level.

Nevertheless, most investors remain optimistic about the economy. A BofA fund‑manager survey released on Tuesday showed half of respondents expect a soft landing, 42% anticipate a “no‑landing” scenario of continued or accelerating growth, and only 3% foresee a recession.
“We think the market is under‑estimating the probability of a hard landing,” Hartnett said.

He worries the market could fall into a vicious cycle: if GDP and corporate earnings‑per‑share forecasts are revised down, investors cut equity exposure, adding further selling pressure to existing holdings.
Hartnett noted that investors are currently fleeing into low‑volatility and defensive stocks, reflecting a search for relatively stable positions amid market turbulence.

Timing his trades, he advises investors to wait for the market story to shift from Fed hikes to cuts before buying what he calls the five “C’s” of the economic cycle: Crypto, Chips, Copper, Consumer and Condos.

items.title: ABB機器人出售案遭北京封殺 分拆上市重回選項 軟銀恐付分手費
items.title_en: ABB Robot Sale Blocked by Beijing, Spin‑off Relisted as Option, SoftBank May Face Break‑up Fee
paras: 瑞士工程集團ABB(ABB-US)出售機器人部門給軟銀(9984-JP)的54億美元交易，11月初遭中國監管機關否決。知情人士透露，ABB考慮讓機器人部門分拆上市作為備案。
軟銀11月6日公告，11月4日接獲中國外商投資安全審查工作機制辦公室通知，禁止收購ABB機器人業務在中國的部分。軟銀當時表示與ABB密切對話，雙方建設性推動交易。
《金融時報》報導，北京擔心機器人生產數據外流海外、被用來訓練AI模型，可能包括軟銀持有重大股權的OpenAI旗下模型，當局並審視相關智慧財產權是否必須留在中國。
知情人士說，雙方正研議重組交易，選項之一是把占機器人部門約三成的中國業務切出，售予中國企業或讓它在當地上市。雙方仍希望數週內達成解方，但談判可能拖到明年。
路透報導，若重組失敗，ABB考慮讓機器人部門分拆上市，或另售其他買家，上市地點與目標估值尚未確定。知情人士另稱，交易若破局，軟銀可能需要支付分手費。
中國是ABB機器人部門最大市場，貢獻營收約三成。ABB在中國有約30家公司、1.5萬名員工，供應中國客戶的機器人逾九成在當地製造，上海工廠2022年啟用、耗資1.5億美元。
ABB機器人部門2026年前三季營收17億美元，淨虧損2300萬美元。ABB早在2025年4月就規劃讓該部門獨立上市，後因軟銀出價更具吸引力而轉向出售，此次是交易受阻後重啟分拆備案。
ABB原本預期出售淨收益約53億美元投入併購，近期剛以55億美元收購英國自動化公司Rotork。根據美國自動化促進協會，ABB與發那科、安川電機及KUKA並列全球主要機器手臂製造商。
美中AI競賽升溫之際，北京加強審查涉及前沿科技的外資交易。本案是今年第二樁遭中國攔下的重大併購，4月Meta(META-US)才被下令撤銷對AI新創Manus逾20億美元的收購。
ABB與軟銀目前對重組討論不予置評。ABB先前僅表示正與軟銀建設性合作，軟銀則稱如有需要揭露的決定將即時公告。
paras_en: Swiss engineering group ABB (ABB-US) had its $5.4 billion deal to sell its robotics division to SoftBank (9984-JP) rejected by Chinese regulators in early November. Insiders say ABB is considering a spin‑off of the robotics unit as a backup plan.

SoftBank announced on November 6 that on November 4 it received a notice from China’s Office for the Review of Foreign Investment Security, prohibiting the acquisition of parts of ABB’s robotics business in China. SoftBank said it was in close dialogue with ABB and both parties were constructively advancing the deal.

The Financial Times reported that Beijing worries robotics production data could flow overseas and be used to train AI models, potentially including those from OpenAI, in which SoftBank holds a significant stake, and is reviewing whether related intellectual property must remain in China.

Sources said the parties are discussing restructuring options, one of which is to carve out roughly 30% of the robotics business that operates in China, selling it to a Chinese firm or listing it locally. Both sides hope to reach a solution within weeks, though negotiations could extend into next year.

Reuters reported that if the restructuring fails, ABB may spin off the robotics unit or sell it to another buyer, with the listing venue and target valuation yet to be determined. Insiders added that a deal collapse could require SoftBank to pay a break‑up fee.

China is the largest market for ABB’s robotics division, accounting for about 30% of its revenue. ABB has around 30 sites and 15,000 employees in China, and over 90% of the robots supplied to Chinese customers are manufactured locally, including a Shanghai plant opened in 2022 at a cost of $150 million.

ABB’s robotics division posted $1.7 billion in revenue and a $23 million net loss for the first three quarters of 2026. ABB had planned to list the unit independently in April 2025, but switched to a sale after SoftBank’s offer proved more attractive; the current spin‑off plan is a fallback after the blocked sale.

ABB originally expected net proceeds of about $5.3 billion from the sale to fund acquisitions, and recently spent $5.5 billion to acquire UK automation firm Rotork. According to the US Automation Association, ABB ranks alongside FANUC, Yaskawa and KUKA as a leading global robot‑arm manufacturer.

Amid a heated US‑China AI race, Beijing has tightened scrutiny of foreign‑investment deals involving frontier technologies. This is the second major acquisition blocked in China this year, after a March order forced Meta (META-US) to abandon a $2 billion purchase of AI startup Manus.

ABB and SoftBank declined to comment on the restructuring talks. ABB previously said it was working constructively with SoftBank, while SoftBank said any material decisions would be disclosed promptly.

items.title: 特斯拉、SpaceX最快12月合併？HSBC：馬斯克持股將達60%、爲股東帶來33%溢價
items.title_en: Tesla, SpaceX Could Merge as Early as December? HSBC: Musk's Stake Will Reach 60% and Deliver a 33% Premium to Shareholders
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 可能合併的消息，正改變市場評估特斯拉股價的方式。滙豐（HSBC）分析師Tyndall周五（20日）在報告中指出，若兩家公司合併，投資人關注焦點將從企業本身的營運價值，轉向潛在收購價格。不過，他認為，目前尚不容易看出兩家公司合併的明確策略效益，推測取得控制權才是主要動機。
根據《Benzinga》報導，Tyndall將特斯拉投資評等從「減碼」（Reduce）調升至「中立」（Hold），目標價也從157美元大幅上調至359美元。至於SpaceX，他維持「中立」評等，目標價維持150美元。
Tyndall指出，SpaceX執行長馬斯克在10月20日舉行的第三季財報電話會議上，曾透露公司已成立工作小組，研究與特斯拉合併的可能性，但並未提供具體時間表。
此外，HSBC則引用《彭博》11月12日一篇未經證實報導，指出這筆交易最快可能於12月宣布。
Tyndall認為，特斯拉與SpaceX面對的客戶群不同且多元，兩家公司合併所能創造的營運綜效並不明顯。
兩家公司在人工智慧（AI）、資料中心及大型語言模型（LLM）領域，都需要大量記憶體，或許是較合理的合作理由。不過，這方面的需求理論上已可透過兩家公司共同成立的晶片設計與製造合資企業Terafab來滿足。
Tyndall指出，合併的主要動機可能在於控制權，尤其馬斯克過去曾明確表達自己需要掌握監督權。
目前馬斯克持有SpaceX約39%股權，以及特斯拉約20%股權。SpaceX採雙重股權結構，主要由馬斯克持有的B類股票每股投票權是A類股票的10倍，因此儘管馬斯克持股39%，實際投票權卻高達70%。
基於這項股權結構，Tyndall進一步評估由SpaceX收購特斯拉的可能情境。
他以特斯拉近30個交易日的平均股價為基準，套用近期類似交易常見的33%收購溢價，推算特斯拉每股收購價約為507美元。若交易完成，馬斯克在合併後公司的持股比例將降至約60%。
Tyndall指出，特斯拉與SpaceX目前消耗現金的速度都高於創造現金的能力。
他假設，若兩家公司都需要透過增資來填補自由現金流缺口，納入特斯拉可能對SpaceX更有利，因為相較於火箭公司，特斯拉的資本支出需求較低。
HSBC估計，合併後SpaceX股東可因未來股權稀釋幅度降低而獲得2.1%至11.1%的利益，特斯拉股東則可享有33%的收購溢價。
隨著合併可能性浮現，Tyndall也調整特斯拉的估值方式。
他過去主要採用折現現金流（DCF）模型，根據企業預估未來現金流推算價值，並搭配同業比較進行評估。不過，他認為，在潛在合併交易成為市場焦點後，收購價值比同業估值更具參考意義。
因此，他將DCF估值與每股507美元的潛在收購價各占一半權重。其中，DCF模型推算的特斯拉合理價值為每股212美元。
報告也提到，馬斯克曾表示，要取得50%特斯拉股東支持「是一道相當高的門檻」。
Tyndall表示，由於合併議題預料將持續主導市場討論，他認為股價進一步下跌的空間有限。
周五收盤，特斯拉股價下跌7.64%，報345.82美元；SpaceX股價下跌7.69%，報127.79美元。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) may be merging, a development that is reshaping how the market values Tesla’s stock. HSBC analyst Tyndall noted on Friday (the 20th) that if the two companies combine, investors’ focus will shift from the operating value of the businesses to the potential acquisition price. However, he believes it is still difficult to see a clear strategic benefit from a merger and assumes that gaining control is the primary motive.

According to a Benzinga report, Tyndall upgraded Tesla’s investment rating from “Reduce” to “Hold” and lifted the target price sharply from $157 to $359. For SpaceX he kept a “Hold” rating with a target price of $150.

Tyndall said SpaceX CEO Elon Musk disclosed during the Q3 earnings call on October 20 that a working group had been formed to explore a possible merger with Tesla, but no specific timetable was provided.
HSBC also cited an unverified Bloomberg report from November 12 that the deal could be announced as early as December.
Tyndall believes the two firms serve very different and diverse customer bases, so any operating synergies from a merger are not obvious.

Both companies need large amounts of memory for AI, data‑center and large‑language‑model work, which could be a more plausible reason to cooperate. In theory, that demand could be met through Terafab, a chip‑design and manufacturing joint venture the two firms have set up together.
Tyndall pointed out that the main driver of a merger may be control, especially since Musk has repeatedly said he wants to retain supervisory authority.

Musk currently holds about 39% of SpaceX and roughly 20% of Tesla. SpaceX uses a dual‑class share structure, with Musk’s Class B shares carrying ten votes per share compared with Class A, giving him about 70% of the voting power despite a 39% equity stake.
Based on that share structure, Tyndall further evaluated a scenario in which SpaceX would acquire Tesla.

Using Tesla’s average price over the last 30 trading days and applying a typical 33% acquisition premium seen in recent comparable deals, he estimated a per‑share purchase price of about $507. If the deal closed, Musk’s stake in the combined company would fall to roughly 60%.
Tyndall noted that both Tesla and SpaceX are burning cash faster than they are generating it.

He assumed that if both companies needed to raise capital to cover free‑cash‑flow gaps, the inclusion of Tesla would be more beneficial to SpaceX because Tesla’s capital‑expenditure needs are lower than those of a rocket company.
HSBC estimates that after the merger SpaceX shareholders could gain 2.1%‑11.1% benefit from reduced future dilution, while Tesla shareholders would enjoy a 33% acquisition premium.
As the merger possibility emerges, Tyndall also adjusted Tesla’s valuation approach.

He previously relied mainly on a discounted cash‑flow (DCF) model, projecting value from expected future cash flows and benchmarking against peers. He now believes that once a potential merger becomes the market focus, the acquisition price is more informative than peer multiples.
Accordingly, he gave equal weight to the DCF valuation and the $507 per‑share potential purchase price. The DCF model implies a fair value of $212 per share for Tesla.
The report also mentioned that Musk has said securing support from 50% of Tesla shareholders is “a fairly high hurdle.”
Tyndall said that because the merger topic is expected to dominate market discussion, there is limited upside for further price declines.
On Friday’s close, Tesla fell 7.64% to $345.82, while SpaceX dropped 7.69% to $127.79.

items.title: 台股本周跌7641點35年來最慘、金管會祭「有條件禁空令」、外銷訂單連21紅 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Falls 7,641 Points This Week – Worst in 35 Years, Financial Supervisory Commission Issues Conditional Short‑Selling Ban, Export Orders Rise for 21 Consecutive Months – Weekly Highlights
paras: 台股本周狂瀉7641.83點，跌幅達17.5%，創1990年以來單周最慘紀錄；金管會周四(19日)宣布，祭出五大穩定股市措施，並重啟有條件禁空令；經濟部統計處周五(20日)公布10月外銷訂單達1238.2億美元，連21紅，持續創單月新高，以下為本周大事回顧：

限空令2.0擋不住賣壓狂瀉2393點創史上第三大跌點 本周跌逾7000點跌幅17.5% 

電子權值股、傳產周五(20日)全倒，上市櫃365家公司慘亮綠燈，即便金管會祭出「有條件禁空令」，仍擋不住沈重賣壓，台股今天早盤以37646.13點開低後一路下殺，一度跌至35738.68點，終場跌2393.6點或6.23%，創史上第三大跌點，收36033.29點，成交量8773.5億元。台股本周狂瀉7641.83點，跌幅17.5%，周線收黑。

台股殺不停 金管會祭「有條件禁空令」等五大穩盤措施上路 

台股跌跌不休，為維持證券市場秩序與穩定性，金管會周四(19日)宣布，自周五(20四)起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，當日收盤跌幅達3.5%以上，次一交易日不得低於前一交易日收盤價放空，並將每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限由3%大砍至1%，同時鼓勵金融業逢低買進績優股及上市櫃公司實施庫藏股，全力提振市場信心。

〈外銷訂單〉21紅！10月外銷訂單1238億美元連3月破千億 續創單月新高 

經濟部統計處周五(20日)公布10月外銷訂單金額一舉衝上 1238.2 億美元，不僅較上月增加 96.1 億美元或成長 8.4%，更較去年同月大增 543.9 億美元或激增 78.3%，連續第 3 個月站穩千億美元大關並改寫歷年單月新高紀錄。累計今年 1 至 10 月外銷訂單達 9430.2 億美元，較去年同期大幅增加 3484.9 億美元，年增幅達 58.6%，整體接單表現極為強勁。

千金股升降單位調整為1元、盤中零股撮合縮短至1秒 明年7/5上路 

證交所持續提升證券市場交易效率及價格品質，打造更友善的投資環境，自2026年12月7日起，推出第一階段制度優化措施，盤中零股交易委託申報時間及交易時間調整與整股同步，自2027年7月5日起，推出第二階段制度優化措施，股價1,000元以上股票之交易升降單位由5元調整為1元，並將盤中零股交易撮合間隔由現行5秒縮短至1秒。

〈玉山金法說〉陳茂欽看川普內政「跛鴨期」轉拚外交壓通膨 估台年底溫和升息半碼 

面對美國期中選舉後政經新局與國內資金外流壓力，玉山金控(2884-TW)周二(17日)舉行法說會，總經理陳茂欽與財務長程國榮皆認為，受通膨黏性與外資今年狂賣台股3兆元影響，市場實質利率已緊縮2至3碼，台灣央行年底仍具升息半碼的條件；陳茂欽指出，全球沒有一個國家面臨通膨還能勝選，美國川普政府進入「跛鴨期」，未來 2 年施政重心將轉向外交，力拚解決二大戰事以壓低油價與通膨。

13家金控10月獲利遇亂流僅這2家月增 前10月合賺近6680億元 

13 家上市金控 2026 年 10 月自結獲利全數出爐！受股債匯動盪壓抑投資評價與資本利得表現影響，整體金控單月獲利明顯降溫，13 家合計稅後純益為 361.09 億元，較 9 月的 529.74 億元月減約 31.8%，僅國泰金、台新新光金呈現月增，其餘 11 家皆呈衰退；不過，受惠於前 9 月累積的厚實獲利基礎，13 家金控前 10 月累計稅後純益仍高達 6,679.88 億元，較去年同期成長 31.8%。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market plunged 7,641.83 points this week, a 17.5% drop, marking the worst single‑week performance since 1990; the Financial Supervisory Commission announced on Thursday (the 19th) five major measures to stabilise the market and reinstated a conditional short‑selling ban; the Ministry of Economic Affairs' Statistics Department reported on Friday (the 20th) that October export orders reached US$123.82 billion, the 21st consecutive month of growth and a new monthly record, summarising the week’s key events:

The new short‑selling restriction (Version 2.0) could not stop the massive sell‑off, which saw a historic 2,393‑point drop – the third‑largest point decline ever. Electronic‑sector heavyweights and traditional industries all fell on Friday (the 20th); 365 listed companies flashed red lights. Even with the conditional short‑selling ban, heavy selling pressure persisted. The market opened lower at 37,646.13 points, slid to a low of 35,738.68, and closed down 2,393.6 points or 6.23% at 36,033.29 with a turnover of NT$877.35 billion. Overall, the index fell 7,641.83 points this week, a 17.5% decline, ending the week in the red.

The market kept falling, prompting the Financial Supervisory Commission on Thursday (the 19th) to roll out five stabilisation measures starting Friday (the 20th). These include reinstating the conditional short‑selling ban – if a day's closing drop exceeds 3.5%, short‑selling is prohibited the next trading day at prices below the previous close – and cutting the daily intraday borrowing‑to‑sell limit from 3% to 1%. The commission also urged financial institutions to buy quality stocks on dips and encouraged listed companies to conduct share buy‑backs, aiming to boost market confidence.

Export orders posted a 21‑month streak of growth. The Ministry of Economic Affairs' Statistics Department announced on Friday (the 20th) that October export orders surged to US$123.82 billion, up US$9.61 billion (8.4%) from the previous month and up US$54.39 billion (78.3%) year‑on‑year. This marks the third consecutive month above the US$100 billion threshold and sets a new all‑time monthly high. Cumulative export orders for January‑October this year totalled US$943.02 billion, a rise of US$348.49 billion (58.6%) over the same period last year, indicating very strong order intake.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange is enhancing trading efficiency and price quality. Starting 7 December 2026, the first phase of system upgrades will align the submission and execution times for intraday odd‑lot trades with those for round‑lot trades. From 5 July 2027, the second phase will reduce the price‑tick for stocks priced above NT$1,000 from NT$5 to NT$1 and shorten the odd‑lot matching interval from the current five seconds to one second.

E.SUN Financial Holding (2884‑TW) held its earnings briefing on Tuesday (the 17th). General manager Chen Mao‑qin and CFO Cheng Kuo‑rong said that, amid the post‑midterm‑election political landscape in the United States and domestic capital outflows, sticky inflation and foreign investors’ sell‑off of NT$3 trillion of Taiwanese stocks have tightened real market rates by 20‑30 basis points, leaving room for a half‑point rate hike by the central bank by year‑end. Chen noted that no country can win an election while still battling inflation; the Trump administration is in a “lame‑duck” phase and will shift its focus to diplomacy over the next two years, seeking to resolve two major conflicts to lower oil prices and inflation.

Thirteen listed financial holding companies reported their October 2026 self‑calculated earnings. Turbulence in equities, bonds and foreign exchange suppressed investment valuations and capital‑gain performance, causing a clear cooling of monthly profits. The 13 firms posted a combined after‑tax net profit of NT$36.109 billion, down about 31.8% from September’s NT$52.974 billion. Only Cathay Financial and Taishin‑Shin Kong Financial showed month‑over‑month growth; the other eleven declined. Nevertheless, thanks to strong earnings accumulated through September, the 13 firms’ cumulative after‑tax profit for the first ten months reached NT$667.988 billion, up 31.8% year‑on‑year.

items.title: 郭明錤：Google明年下修博通TPU出貨約百萬顆 「聯發科」可望受惠
items.title_en: Ming-Chi Kuo: Google to Cut Next Year’s Broadcom TPU Shipments by About 1 Million Units, MediaTek Likely to Benefit
paras: Google 傳出調整 2027 年人工智慧 (AI) 晶片出貨規劃。天風國際證券分析師郭明錤最新產業調查指出，Google 將博通 (AVGO-US) 設計的 TPU 8i 系列出貨量下修約 100 萬顆，相當於原估全年出貨量的約 20%，同時預計增加聯發科 (2454-TW) 設計的 TPU 8t 系列出貨，但細節尚未確定。
《Seeking Alpha》報導，郭明錤週五 (20 日) 在社群平台發文表示，這次 TPU 8i 系列出貨下修，主要集中於單價較高的 8i Max，該產品代號為 Whalefish。
郭明錤指出，Google 近幾個月反覆強調，前沿模型研發將優先取得算力。此次調整 TPU 8t 與 8i 系列的出貨比重，正是在供應鏈緊張與資料中心供電受限的情況下，配合算力優先順序所做的安排。
這項調查顯示，Google 正重新分配不同 TPU 系列的供應資源。
博通設計的 8i 系列遭下修，聯發科設計的 8t 系列則預計增加，但由於後者的新增數量尚未敲定，目前無法確認能否抵銷前者減少的規模。
對博通而言，下修集中於單價較高的 8i Max，意味除了出貨數量，產品組合變化也可能影響相關營收。
不過，調查未揭露實際售價與訂單金額，尚無法量化財務衝擊。
聯發科則有望隨 8t 系列增量，提高在 Google TPU 出貨配置中的比重，實際受惠程度仍待最終規劃確認。
由於目前揭露的是不同 TPU 系列之間的配置調整，且 8t 增量尚未明朗，仍不足以據此判定 Google 將縮減整體 TPU 出貨或 AI 資本支出。
paras_en: Google has revised its 2027 AI chip shipment plan, with analyst Ming-Chi Kuo of TSMC Securities noting that shipments of Broadcom (AVGO-US)‑designed TPU 8i series will be cut by about 1 million units, roughly 20% of the original annual estimate, while shipments of MediaTek (2454‑TW)‑designed TPU 8t series are expected to rise, though details remain unclear.
Seeking Alpha reported that Kuo posted on social media on Friday (20th) that the cut in TPU 8i shipments mainly affects the higher‑priced 8i Max model, code‑named Whalefish.

Kuo said Google has repeatedly emphasized that cutting‑edge model development will prioritize computing power, and the adjustment of shipment shares between TPU 8t and 8i series reflects supply‑chain tightness and data‑center power limits, aligned with computing‑priority order.
The survey shows Google is reallocating supply resources among different TPU series.

Broadcom’s 8i series is being cut, while MediaTek’s 8t series is expected to increase, but the exact additional quantity has not been finalized, so it is unclear whether the increase will offset the reduction in the former.
For Broadcom, the cut focuses on the higher‑priced 8i Max, meaning that changes in product mix could also affect related revenue, not just shipment volume.
However, the survey did not disclose actual pricing or order amounts, so the financial impact cannot yet be quantified.
MediaTek is expected to benefit from the 8t series increase, raising its share of Google TPU shipments, though the extent of the benefit will depend on final plans.

Because the current disclosure only shows configuration adjustments between different TPU series and the 8t increase is still unclear, it is premature to conclude that Google will reduce overall TPU shipments or AI capital spending.

items.title: CrowdStrike洽購Zscaler ZS盤後飆18% 資安整併潮延燒
items.title_en: CrowdStrike Negotiates Acquisition of Zscaler, Shares Surge 18% After Hours
paras: 彭博引述知情人士報導，資安大廠CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)正洽談收購同業Zscaler(ZS-US)，協商持續進行，可能近期達成協議但不保證成案，成交價碼尚未確定。
消息在20日美股收盤後曝光，Zscaler盤後飆漲18%，CrowdStrike跌逾8%。《Investing.com》分析，這反映投資人為Zscaler計入收購溢價，並權衡收購方稀釋風險。
CrowdStrike是今年AI熱潮的資安大贏家，股價約翻倍、市值達2350億美元，Falcon平台保護筆電與伺服器等端點。Zscaler主打雲端安全，今年股價跌13%，市值約320億美元。
近年資安整併不斷，Google(GOOGL-US)去年以320億美元收購Wiz，思科(CSCO-US)2024年以約280億美元買下Splunk，均為該領域指標交易。
Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)今年也以250億美元完成收購CyberArk，20日收盤市值近2820億美元，業務同樣受惠AI時代企業競相升級網路防護的需求。
《Investing.com》報導，資安股盤後連動：Palo Alto Networks跌逾3%，投資人評估對手壯大；Okta(OKTA-US)漲近3%，Fortinet漲近2%。
CrowdStrike過往併購規模偏小，本月稍早才宣布收購代理式可觀測性平台Fiddler AI與AI信任平台Dreadnode。若對Zscaler出手，將是該公司併購策略的重大升級。
CrowdStrike對相關報導拒絕置評，Zscaler未立即回覆置評請求。兩家公司能否談成、以何種價碼成交，目前都還沒有答案。
paras_en: Bloomberg cited sources saying cybersecurity giant CrowdStrike (CRWD-US) is in talks to acquire peer Zscaler (ZS-US); negotiations are ongoing and a deal could be reached soon, though no commitment has been made and the purchase price is still undetermined.

The news broke after the U.S. market closed on the 20th, with Zscaler’s shares jumping 18% in after‑hours trading while CrowdStrike fell more than 8%. Investing.com analysis suggested that investors priced in an acquisition premium for Zscaler and weighed the dilution risk for the buyer.

CrowdStrike has been a major winner in this year’s AI boom, with its stock roughly doubling and a market cap of $235 billion; its Falcon platform protects laptops and servers among other endpoints. Zscaler, which focuses on cloud security, saw its stock fall 13% this year and has a market cap of about $32 billion.

Security consolidation has been relentless in recent years: Google (GOOGL-US) acquired Wiz for $32 billion last year, Cisco (CSCO-US) bought Splunk for about $28 billion in 2024, all landmark deals in the sector.

Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) also completed a $25 billion acquisition of CyberArk this year, and its market cap was nearly $282 billion at the close on the 20th, benefiting from the AI era’s demand for upgraded network protection.

Investing.com reported that cybersecurity stocks moved in tandem after hours: Palo Alto Networks fell over 3% as investors assessed a stronger competitor; Okta (OKTA-US) rose nearly 3%, and Fortinet gained almost 2%.

CrowdStrike’s past acquisitions have been relatively modest; earlier this month it announced the purchase of the agent‑based observability platform Fiddler AI and the AI‑trust platform Dreadnode. A bid for Zscaler would represent a significant upgrade to its acquisition strategy.
CrowdStrike declined to comment on the reports, and Zscaler has not yet responded to a request for comment. Whether the two companies can reach an agreement and at what price remains unanswered.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉宣德低軌衛星業務明年估增3成 無懼大盤逆風飆漲停周漲15%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Xuan De (5457‑TW) Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellite Business Expected to Grow 30% Next Year, Rides Up Despite Market Headwinds, Hits Daily Limit, Up Over 15% This Week
paras: 連接器廠宣德(5457-TW)低軌衛星布局持續擴大，明年相關業務營收可望年增3成、占比將達1成以上，近期無懼大盤重挫，股價逆勢抗跌，周五收漲停23.75元、周漲逾15%。
宣德表示，2026至2028年為低軌衛星產業高速成長期，其中地面接收站相關產品年成長率可望突破4成，並積極擴大零組件布局，涵蓋內外部機構件、連接器及線束等，提高產品滲透率與單機價值。
其中，機殼相關專案今年已取得訂單，交由子公司台翰負責，目前已有少量出貨，預計2027年開始放量，進一步挹注營收，公司也將配合客戶全球擴張進程，持續推動低軌衛星業務規模化。
除低軌衛星外，宣德也持續拓展工控產品整機組裝業務，從過去以零組件供應為主，進一步延伸至整機組裝，應用涵蓋遊戲機台、POS機、ATM及安控設備等，目前已有專案進行中，且今年已開始貢獻營收。
此外，在工業及支付設備方面，宣德也布局專業耳機、POS機及RFID掃描器等產品，應用於地勤、客服及零售感應收銀等場景，相關產品今年同樣開始貢獻營收，成為既有消費電子業務以外的新成長來源。
paras_en: Connector maker Xuan De (5457‑TW) continues to expand its low‑Earth‑orbit satellite portfolio, with related revenue expected to increase 30% year‑over‑year next year and account for more than 10% of total sales. Recently the stock has resisted a broad market sell‑off, closing Friday at the daily limit of NT$23.75 and gaining more than 15% for the week.

Xuan De said the period 2026‑2028 will be a high‑growth phase for the LEO satellite industry, with ground‑station products projected to grow at an annual rate of over 40%. The company is actively expanding its component lineup, covering internal and external mechanical parts, connectors and wiring harnesses to boost product penetration and unit value.

The company’s enclosure‑related projects secured orders this year and were handed to its subsidiary Tai‑Han for production; a small volume has already been shipped, and volume production is expected to start in 2027, further fueling revenue. Xuan De will also align with customers’ global expansion plans to scale up its LEO satellite business.

Beyond LEO satellites, Xuan De is expanding its industrial‑control product assembly business, moving from a pure component supplier to full‑machine assembly. Applications include gaming machines, POS terminals, ATMs and security equipment; several projects are underway and have begun contributing to revenue this year.

In addition, in the industrial and payment‑equipment sectors, Xuan De is developing professional headsets, POS terminals and RFID scanners for use in ground‑crew, customer‑service and retail checkout scenarios. These products also started generating revenue this year, providing a new growth source beyond its existing consumer‑electronics business.

items.title: 台股本周跌7641點35年來最慘、金管會祭「有條件禁空令」、外銷訂單連21紅 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Falls 7,641 Points This Week – Worst in 35 Years, Financial Supervisory Commission Issues Conditional Short‑Selling Ban, Export Orders Rise for 21 Consecutive Months – Weekly Highlights
paras: 台股本周狂瀉7641.83點，跌幅達17.5%，創1990年以來單周最慘紀錄；金管會周四(19日)宣布，祭出五大穩定股市措施，並重啟有條件禁空令；經濟部統計處周五(20日)公布10月外銷訂單達1238.2億美元，連21紅，持續創單月新高，以下為本周大事回顧：

限空令2.0擋不住賣壓狂瀉2393點創史上第三大跌點 本周跌逾7000點跌幅17.5% 

電子權值股、傳產周五(20日)全倒，上市櫃365家公司慘亮綠燈，即便金管會祭出「有條件禁空令」，仍擋不住沈重賣壓，台股今天早盤以37646.13點開低後一路下殺，一度跌至35738.68點，終場跌2393.6點或6.23%，創史上第三大跌點，收36033.29點，成交量8773.5億元。台股本周狂瀉7641.83點，跌幅17.5%，周線收黑。

台股殺不停 金管會祭「有條件禁空令」等五大穩盤措施上路 

台股跌跌不休，為維持證券市場秩序與穩定性，金管會周四(19日)宣布，自周五(20四)起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，當日收盤跌幅達3.5%以上，次一交易日不得低於前一交易日收盤價放空，並將每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限由3%大砍至1%，同時鼓勵金融業逢低買進績優股及上市櫃公司實施庫藏股，全力提振市場信心。

〈外銷訂單〉21紅！10月外銷訂單1238億美元連3月破千億 續創單月新高 

經濟部統計處周五(20日)公布10月外銷訂單金額一舉衝上 1238.2 億美元，不僅較上月增加 96.1 億美元或成長 8.4%，更較去年同月大增 543.9 億美元或激增 78.3%，連續第 3 個月站穩千億美元大關並改寫歷年單月新高紀錄。累計今年 1 至 10 月外銷訂單達 9430.2 億美元，較去年同期大幅增加 3484.9 億美元，年增幅達 58.6%，整體接單表現極為強勁。

千金股升降單位調整為1元、盤中零股撮合縮短至1秒 明年7/5上路 

證交所持續提升證券市場交易效率及價格品質，打造更友善的投資環境，自2026年12月7日起，推出第一階段制度優化措施，盤中零股交易委託申報時間及交易時間調整與整股同步，自2027年7月5日起，推出第二階段制度優化措施，股價1,000元以上股票之交易升降單位由5元調整為1元，並將盤中零股交易撮合間隔由現行5秒縮短至1秒。

〈玉山金法說〉陳茂欽看川普內政「跛鴨期」轉拚外交壓通膨 估台年底溫和升息半碼 

面對美國期中選舉後政經新局與國內資金外流壓力，玉山金控(2884-TW)周二(17日)舉行法說會，總經理陳茂欽與財務長程國榮皆認為，受通膨黏性與外資今年狂賣台股3兆元影響，市場實質利率已緊縮2至3碼，台灣央行年底仍具升息半碼的條件；陳茂欽指出，全球沒有一個國家面臨通膨還能勝選，美國川普政府進入「跛鴨期」，未來 2 年施政重心將轉向外交，力拚解決二大戰事以壓低油價與通膨。

13家金控10月獲利遇亂流僅這2家月增 前10月合賺近6680億元 

13 家上市金控 2026 年 10 月自結獲利全數出爐！受股債匯動盪壓抑投資評價與資本利得表現影響，整體金控單月獲利明顯降溫，13 家合計稅後純益為 361.09 億元，較 9 月的 529.74 億元月減約 31.8%，僅國泰金、台新新光金呈現月增，其餘 11 家皆呈衰退；不過，受惠於前 9 月累積的厚實獲利基礎，13 家金控前 10 月累計稅後純益仍高達 6,679.88 億元，較去年同期成長 31.8%。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market plunged 7,641.83 points this week, a 17.5% drop, marking the worst single‑week performance since 1990; the Financial Supervisory Commission announced on Thursday (the 19th) five major measures to stabilise the market and reinstated a conditional short‑selling ban; the Ministry of Economic Affairs' Statistics Department reported on Friday (the 20th) that October export orders reached US$123.82 billion, the 21st consecutive month of growth and a new monthly record, summarising the week’s key events:

The new short‑selling restriction (Version 2.0) could not stop the massive sell‑off, which saw a historic 2,393‑point drop – the third‑largest point decline ever. Electronic‑sector heavyweights and traditional industries all fell on Friday (the 20th); 365 listed companies flashed red lights. Even with the conditional short‑selling ban, heavy selling pressure persisted. The market opened lower at 37,646.13 points, slid to a low of 35,738.68, and closed down 2,393.6 points or 6.23% at 36,033.29 with a turnover of NT$877.35 billion. Overall, the index fell 7,641.83 points this week, a 17.5% decline, ending the week in the red.

The market kept falling, prompting the Financial Supervisory Commission on Thursday (the 19th) to roll out five stabilisation measures starting Friday (the 20th). These include reinstating the conditional short‑selling ban – if a day's closing drop exceeds 3.5%, short‑selling is prohibited the next trading day at prices below the previous close – and cutting the daily intraday borrowing‑to‑sell limit from 3% to 1%. The commission also urged financial institutions to buy quality stocks on dips and encouraged listed companies to conduct share buy‑backs, aiming to boost market confidence.

Export orders posted a 21‑month streak of growth. The Ministry of Economic Affairs' Statistics Department announced on Friday (the 20th) that October export orders surged to US$123.82 billion, up US$9.61 billion (8.4%) from the previous month and up US$54.39 billion (78.3%) year‑on‑year. This marks the third consecutive month above the US$100 billion threshold and sets a new all‑time monthly high. Cumulative export orders for January‑October this year totalled US$943.02 billion, a rise of US$348.49 billion (58.6%) over the same period last year, indicating very strong order intake.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange is enhancing trading efficiency and price quality. Starting 7 December 2026, the first phase of system upgrades will align the submission and execution times for intraday odd‑lot trades with those for round‑lot trades. From 5 July 2027, the second phase will reduce the price‑tick for stocks priced above NT$1,000 from NT$5 to NT$1 and shorten the odd‑lot matching interval from the current five seconds to one second.

E.SUN Financial Holding (2884‑TW) held its earnings briefing on Tuesday (the 17th). General manager Chen Mao‑qin and CFO Cheng Kuo‑rong said that, amid the post‑midterm‑election political landscape in the United States and domestic capital outflows, sticky inflation and foreign investors’ sell‑off of NT$3 trillion of Taiwanese stocks have tightened real market rates by 20‑30 basis points, leaving room for a half‑point rate hike by the central bank by year‑end. Chen noted that no country can win an election while still battling inflation; the Trump administration is in a “lame‑duck” phase and will shift its focus to diplomacy over the next two years, seeking to resolve two major conflicts to lower oil prices and inflation.

Thirteen listed financial holding companies reported their October 2026 self‑calculated earnings. Turbulence in equities, bonds and foreign exchange suppressed investment valuations and capital‑gain performance, causing a clear cooling of monthly profits. The 13 firms posted a combined after‑tax net profit of NT$36.109 billion, down about 31.8% from September’s NT$52.974 billion. Only Cathay Financial and Taishin‑Shin Kong Financial showed month‑over‑month growth; the other eleven declined. Nevertheless, thanks to strong earnings accumulated through September, the 13 firms’ cumulative after‑tax profit for the first ten months reached NT$667.988 billion, up 31.8% year‑on‑year.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉資安股接棒成大盤中流砥柱 中華資安周漲逾9% 創1年來新高價
items.title_en: Hot Stocks: Cybersecurity Firms Become the Market’s Pillar, China Cybersecurity Rises Over 9% This Week, Hits One‑Year High
paras: 台股加權指數本周坐大怒神，重挫多達17%，少見個股有漲勢，中華資安(7765-TW)逆勢周漲9%，並創2025年11月以來高，合計二周來漲幅超過20%，成大盤中最是中流砥柱的資安股。
法人認為，11月中旬國內發生上櫃電商雲端服務商的客戶資料外洩事件，再次喚起市場對企業資安防護的重視，加上第四季本為政府與大型企業的資安預算核銷與採購傳統旺季，預估中華資安有約4-5億元的在手專案待驗收認列，單季營收有望改寫新高。
據中華民國資通安全發展協會彙整，今年上半年公開揭露資安事件共56起，而下半年截至11月15日已達117起，月平均事件數約為上半年的2.8倍，顯示企業資安風險持續升溫。
目前中華資安以既有客戶為主，惟近期重大資安事件多集中於下半年，相關需求轉化為訂單和營收仍需時間，成長效益尚未完全反映，法人預期將逐步挹注2027年營運表現。
其中，公司目前已掌握約半數年度訂閱型合約，9成以上既有訂閱合約預期將持續續約，提供穩定的經常性收入基礎。
展望2027年，隨著企業資安預算增加、金融監理及資安法規要求趨嚴，加上中華資安持續推出AISOC、雲端資安監控和半導體設備資安檢測等新服務，法人樂觀看待整體營運穩健成長應無虞。
paras_en: The Taiwan weighted index was dominated by a furious sell‑off this week, plunging as much as 17%, with few stocks showing gains. China Cybersecurity (7765‑TW) bucked the trend, jumping 9% for the week and reaching its highest level since November 2025, with a cumulative rise of over 20% across two weeks, making it the most solid pillar among cybersecurity stocks in the market.

Institutions note that a mid‑November data breach at a listed e‑commerce cloud service provider revived market focus on corporate cyber defenses. Coupled with the fourth quarter’s traditional peak in government and large‑enterprise cyber‑security budget approvals and purchases, China Cybersecurity is estimated to have about NT$4‑5 billion in projects pending acceptance, which could push quarterly revenue to a new record.

According to the Taiwan Information Security Development Association, 56 cyber‑security incidents were publicly disclosed in the first half of the year, while by November 15 the second half had already reached 117 cases—about 2.8 times the monthly average of the first half—indicating a continued rise in corporate cyber‑risk.

China Cybersecurity currently relies mainly on existing customers, but major cyber incidents have been concentrated in the second half of the year, so the conversion of related demand into orders and revenue will take time, and growth benefits have not yet been fully reflected. Institutions expect this to gradually feed into the company’s 2027 operating performance.
The company now holds roughly half of its annual subscription contracts, and more than 90% of existing subscription contracts are expected to be renewed, providing a stable base of recurring revenue.

Looking ahead to 2027, with increasing corporate cyber budgets, tighter financial supervision and stricter cyber‑security regulations, and China Cybersecurity’s continued rollout of new services such as AISOC, cloud security monitoring, and semiconductor equipment security testing, institutions are optimistic that overall operations will grow steadily without concern.

items.title: 台股單周重挫7641點！上市櫃市值蒸發逾27兆元 全球市值排名退居第7
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Plunges 7,641 Points in One Week! Listed Companies Lose Over NT$27 Trillion in Market Value, Dropping to 7th in Global Rankings
paras: 台股本周遭遇劇烈震盪，不僅上市櫃總市值單周驟減 27.16 兆元，更直接牽動全球股市版圖洗牌。參考 MarketCapWatch 全球股市市值榜，截至11月20日晚間，台股市值排行已從巔峰時期的全球第4名退居至第7名，落後於美國、中國大陸、日本、印度、英國及加拿大，創下史上首見的資產快速縮水慘況。
根據臺灣證券交易所最新統計，集中市場本周全面走跌，11月20日全體上市公司總市值縮水至 118兆992.45億元，較上周暴減 24.97 兆元，減幅約17.45%；櫃買市場市值同樣一路下滑，繼上周五跌破10兆元大關後，20日再降至7.35兆元，單周減少2.2兆元。
若將時間拉長，集中市場總市值在10月6日曾高達163.75兆元，隨著大盤一路探底，至20日已蒸發超過45兆元，相當於每位投資人平均虧損304萬元。權值王台積電也難逃賣壓，股價從高點2,590元一路滑落至20日盤中低點1,970元，累計下挫620元，連帶使市值縮水15.19兆元。
台股重挫也牽動全球股市排名變化。參考MarketCapWatch全球股市市值榜，截至20日晚間，台股市值排行已從巔峰時期的全球第4名退居至第7名，目前落後於美國、中國大陸、日本、印度、英國及加拿大。

觀察本周集中市場各類股表現，所有產業別指數無一倖免全面收黑，其中以玻璃陶瓷類指數重挫36.68%跌幅最深，居家生活類指數下跌3.84%相對抗跌。本周集中市場總成交金額為4兆8,664.67億元，全體上市股票成交金額則為4兆930.44億元，股票成交量週轉率為2.95%；成交金額前3大產業依序為半導體類1兆7,298.13億元（占42.26%）、電子零組件類8,346.70億元（占20.39%）以及電腦及週邊設備類2,613.72億元（占6.39%）。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced severe volatility this week, with the total market capitalization of listed companies shrinking by NT$27.16 trillion in a single week, a drop that also reshaped the global equity landscape. According to MarketCapWatch’s global market‑cap rankings, by the evening of November 20 the Taiwan market fell from its peak as the world’s fourth‑largest to seventh place, trailing the United States, mainland China, Japan, India, the United Kingdom and Canada, marking an unprecedented rapid contraction of assets.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange’s latest figures show that the main board fell across the board this week. On November 20 the total market value of all listed companies contracted to NT$118 trillion 992.45 billion, a weekly decline of NT$24.97 trillion, or about 17.45%. The OTC market also kept sliding; after breaking the NT$10 trillion threshold last Friday, its value fell further to NT$7.35 trillion on the 20th, a weekly loss of NT$2.2 trillion.

Looking at a longer horizon, the main board’s total market cap peaked at NT$163.75 trillion on October 6. As the index kept sinking, more than NT$45 trillion evaporated by the 20th, equivalent to an average loss of NT$3.04 million per investor. Even the heavyweight TSMC could not escape selling pressure, with its share price sliding from a high of NT$2,590 to a mid‑day low of NT$1,970 on the 20th – a cumulative drop of NT$620 that shaved NT$15.19 trillion off its market value.

The sharp decline of Taiwan’s market also shifted global rankings. According to MarketCapWatch’s global market‑cap list as of the evening of the 20th, Taiwan slipped from its historic peak at fourth place to seventh, now behind the United States, mainland China, Japan, India, the United Kingdom and Canada.

Examining sector performance in the main board this week, every industry index ended in the red. The glass‑ceramics sector suffered the steepest fall, plunging 36.68%, while the home‑life sector managed a modest 3.84% decline, showing relative resilience. Total turnover in the main market amounted to NT$4 trillion 8,664.67 billion, with all listed stocks accounting for NT$4 trillion 930.44 billion and a turnover ratio of 2.95%. The top three industries by transaction value were semiconductors at NT$1 trillion 7,298.13 billion (42.26%), electronic components at NT$8,346.70 billion (20.39%) and computers & peripherals at NT$2,613.72 billion (6.39%).

items.title: 〈熱門股〉松川獲投信首度建倉 營收成長吸引買盤爆量站上5日線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Songchuan Secures First Institutional Investor Position as Revenue Growth Attracts Buyers, Volume Surges and Price Moves Above 5‑Day Moving Average
paras: 在市場需求勁揚帶動下，繼電器廠松川精密(7788-TW)營運也正持續擴張。松川精密擬以發行總額15億元的無擔保可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資，2027年資本支出規劃將維持於4億元的水準，本土投信本周首度進場建倉並連三日進場買超合計達2810張。
松川精密20日股價收在180.5元，上漲6.5元、成交量6787張，也爲上市以來單日成交次高量，收盤股價也站上5日線。
包括松川的首度送件透過資本市場籌資及授信的對松川建立持股部位，都是松川2025年10月16日上市掛牌以來，松川精密本次擬發行無擔保可轉換公司債籌資，主辦券商為元大證券。松川精密並指出，此一市場籌資用途償還銀行借款及充實營運資金。
松川精密的最新財報顯示，2026年1-9月營收68.52億元，已超越2025年全年營收總和，稅後純益6.66億元，年增3.2倍，每股純益8.35元，法人估全年有機會每股賺逾11元，也將創新高。
松川精密本周成交量能充沛，收在180.5元，並站上5日線，後市端視量能能否持續而5日線177.5元也為短線支撐。
paras_en: Amid strong market demand, relay manufacturer Songchuan Precision (7788‑TW) is continuing to expand its operations. The company plans to raise funds by issuing unsecured convertible bonds worth NT$1.5 billion, with capital expenditures slated to stay around NT$400 million in 2027. A domestic mutual fund entered the stock for the first time this week, buying a total of 2,810 lots over three consecutive days.

Songchuan Precision closed at NT$180.5 on the 20th, up NT$6.5, with a trading volume of 6,787 lots – the second‑highest single‑day volume since its listing – and the closing price also moved above its 5‑day moving average.

The company’s inaugural capital‑market fundraising and the mutual fund’s new shareholding both stem from Songchuan’s plan, announced since its October 16, 2025 listing, to issue unsecured convertible bonds. The lead underwriter is Yuanta Securities. Songchuan said the proceeds will be used to repay bank loans and bolster working capital.

Songchuan’s latest financial report shows that revenue for January‑September 2026 reached NT$6.852 billion, already surpassing the total revenue for the entire 2025 year. Net profit after tax was NT$666 million, a 3.2‑fold year‑over‑year increase, translating to earnings of NT$8.35 per share. Analysts estimate the full‑year EPS could exceed NT$11, a new high.

This week’s robust trading saw the stock close at NT$180.5, staying above the 5‑day moving average. Future performance will depend on whether the strong volume can be sustained, with the 5‑day average at NT$177.5 serving as short‑term support.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉視陽矽水膠產品展望正面 外資連4買本周抗跌
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Visionary Silicon Hydrogel Products Outlook Positive, Foreign Investors Buy for Four Consecutive Days This Week Resists Decline
paras: 隱形眼鏡廠視陽(6782-TW)受惠亞洲市場矽水膠彩拋產品需求暢旺，累計今年前三季稅後純益9.3億元，每股純益14.77元，同步創歷史新高，隨著新產能陸續開出，除亞洲矽水膠彩拋產品滲透率提升，也可進一步滿足歐洲客戶訂單，整體展望正面，無懼大盤狂瀉逾7000點，並獲外資連續4個交易日買超，本周相對抗跌，僅小跌0.53%。
視陽本周小跌0.53%，且於周五(20日)一度站回300元關卡，雖隨後翻黑跌2.41%，收283.5元，但相較於台股一片慘綠，本周表現抗跌，並持續站穩所有均線。另外，外資也青睞視陽，連續4個交易買超，本周合計買超998張。
為因應客戶強勁需求，視陽積極擴充產能，第四季月產能已達6300萬片，預計明年第一季將進一步提高至7500萬片，甚至達8000萬片。
展望後市，視陽指出，日本與中國的矽水膠產品仍為視陽主要成長動能，稼動率維持90%以上，且隨著新產能陸續開出，也可逐步滿足歐洲需求，預期第四季及明年第一季都有望淡季不淡、逐季成長。
paras_en: Contact lens maker Visionary (6782‑TW) benefits from strong demand for silicon hydrogel colored contact lenses in the Asian market, posting a cumulative net profit after tax of NT$930 million for the first three quarters of this year and earnings per share of NT$14.77, both record highs. With new capacity coming online, the penetration rate of Asian silicon‑hydrogel colored lenses is rising and the company can also meet European customer orders, giving it a positive outlook despite the market’s plunge of over 7,000 points. Foreign investors have bought the stock for four straight trading days, helping it to hold up this week with only a modest 0.53% decline.

Visionary slipped 0.53% this week and briefly reclaimed the NT$300 level on Friday (the 20th). It then turned negative, falling 2.41% to close at NT$283.5. Compared with the broadly bearish Taiwan market, the stock showed relative resilience, maintaining all its moving averages. Foreign investors also favored Visionary, net‑buying 998 lots over the four‑day streak this week.

To meet strong customer demand, Visionary is aggressively expanding capacity. Monthly production capacity reached 63 million pieces in the fourth quarter and is expected to rise to 75 million pieces in the first quarter of next year, with a potential peak of 80 million pieces.

Looking ahead, Visionary says Japan and China remain its main growth engines for silicon‑hydrogel products, with utilization rates staying above 90%. As new capacity comes online, the company can gradually satisfy European demand, and it expects the fourth quarter and the first quarter of next year to avoid typical seasonal weakness and to achieve sequential growth.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉川湖股價拉回修正仍獲外資承接 前3季狂賺逾23個股本
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Chuanhu’s Share Price Pulls Back Yet Still Attracted Foreign Investors, Q3 Profit Surges Over 23‑Times Equity
paras: 伺服器滑軌廠川湖(2059-TW)近期遭遇大盤拖累賣壓，20日股價持續走弱並打入跌停板5350元作收，下跌590元或9.93%，累計已連7個交易日收黑且波段跌幅達38.72%。儘管本周股價大幅修正，不過外資逆勢買超42張並寫下連2買，累計買超達299張。
其中第三季單季表現更是創下歷史新高，單季營收來到173.4億元、季增逾六成，單季毛利率攀升至88.2個百分點、營益率達82.9個百分點，單季稅後純益為117.0億元，單季每股純益高達122.79元。法人分析指出，第三季獲利爆發主要受惠於客戶新平台推出，帶動高毛利的新世代產品出貨比重提升與產品組合持續優化。
針對短期營運節奏與中長期展望，川湖第四季雖受產品世代轉換影響使營運動能暫時放緩，但法人看好2027年下半年起新平台產品放量將挹注新一波成長動能，對其長線競爭力維持正向看法，預估川湖在GB與VR以及ASIC人工智慧伺服器滑軌市場的市占率超過八成，隨著客製化獨立機櫃設計需求擴大，2026至2027年伺服器滑軌營收占比上看95%-97%。
為因應全球雲端服務供應商強勁的算力設備需求，川湖已提前啟動新一輪產能擴充計畫，美國休士頓新廠於今年9月至10月間正式啟動量產以就近服務北美客戶。同時台灣川億三期與五期廠房擴建進度也較原定規劃提前一年半至兩年，預計新增樓地板面積22萬平方公尺並使現有產能翻倍，加上川湖二廠將於明年完工加入量產，為中長期業績提供充足產能支撐。
paras_en: Server rail manufacturer Chuanhu (2059‑TW) recently faced market‑wide selling pressure, and on the 20th its share price kept weakening, hitting the daily limit down at NT$5,350, down NT$590 or 9.93%. This marks the seventh consecutive trading day of losses and a cumulative decline of 38.72% for the session. Despite the sharp correction this week, foreign investors bought 42 lots against the trend, logging a second consecutive buying day and a total net purchase of 299 lots.

In the third quarter, the company posted a record‑high single‑quarter performance: revenue reached NT$17.34 billion, up more than 60% quarter‑over‑quarter; gross margin climbed to 88.2 percentage points and operating margin hit 82.9 percentage points; net profit after tax was NT$11.70 billion, and earnings per share surged to NT$122.79. Analysts said the profit explosion was mainly driven by customers launching new platforms, which boosted shipments of high‑margin next‑generation products and continued product‑mix optimization.

Regarding short‑term operating rhythm and mid‑to‑long‑term outlook, Chuanhu’s fourth quarter may see a temporary slowdown in momentum due to a product‑generation transition. Nevertheless, analysts are optimistic that from the second half of 2027 onward, new‑platform products will scale up, injecting a fresh wave of growth. They maintain a positive view on the company’s long‑term competitiveness, estimating that Chuanhu will hold over 80% market share in the GB, VR and ASIC AI server rail markets, and that server‑rail revenue will account for 95%‑97% of total sales in 2026‑2027 as customized independent rack designs expand.

To meet the strong demand for compute equipment from global cloud service providers, Chuanhu has already launched a new round of capacity expansion. A new plant in Houston, USA, began mass production in September‑October this year to serve North American customers more closely. Meanwhile, the expansion of Taiwan’s Phase‑3 and Phase‑5 facilities has been accelerated by 1.5‑2 years, adding 220,000 square meters of floor space and doubling existing capacity. In addition, Phase‑2 will be completed next year and join mass production, providing ample capacity support for mid‑to‑long‑term earnings.
